rationale.conceptual: Involves several non-trivial concepts (DFT, DFPT, VCA, surface energy calculations, dislocation-kinetic model) but all are documented in prior literature and the paper gives explicit equations; no truly novel algorithm needs to be derived.
rationale.execution: Multi-stage pipeline with about 6 steps: two DFT geometry optimizations, total energy extraction, six surface slab relaxations, a full DFPT phonon dispersion, and a model fitting script. Orchestrating different DFT input types and post-processing requires careful scripting.

difficulty.reasoning: The task requires standard DFT workflows (bulk relaxation, surface slabs, phonon dispersion via DFPT with VCA) and fitting a dislocation-kinetic model. The conceptual method is moderately complex but uses established techniques; execution involves a multi-step pipeline with DFT codes and data fitting.

compute_estimate.reasoning: DFT calculations on Ti2NiCu with ~500 eV cutoff and moderate k-points (up to 5x5x5) and a DFPT 6x6x6 q-mesh are CPU-intensive but fit in 16 GB RAM; input structures are tiny, no large dataset.
